n = int(input())
k = int(input())
p = int(input())

MAXN = 250010

def qpow(baseVal, y=p-2):
    res = 1
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            res = res * baseVal % p
        baseVal = baseVal * baseVal % p
        y >>= 1
    return res

bits = [0] * (MAXN)
x = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(26)]
fact = [1] * (MAXN)
invFact = [1] * (MAXN)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1)

base = qpow(k, n)

def compute(depth, num):
    if bits[num] < depth:
        return 0
    if depth == 1:
        return x[depth][num]
    if x[depth][num]:
        return x[depth][num]
    count = 0
    mask = num & (num - 1)
    while mask:
        if bits[mask] >= depth - 1:
            x[depth][num] += compute(depth - 1, mask) * x[num ^ mask][num]
            count += 1
            if count == 18:
                count = 0
                x[depth][num] %= p
        mask = mask & (mask - 1)
    x[depth][num] %= p
    return x[depth][num]

def choose(n, m):
    return fact[n] * invFact[m] % p * invFact[n - m] % p

fact[0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p

invFact[n] = qpow(fact[n])
for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
    invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p

limit = min(k, bits[n])
result = 0
for i in range(1, limit + 1):
    result += choose(k, i) * compute(i, n)
result %= p

base = (base - result * fact[n] % p + p) % p
